what_happened: Under augment=false the same finite-positive-measure failure recurred deterministically on two lanes (control epoch 73, mixedres seed 44 at epoch 153 -- the same epoch as its pre-amendment death). The crash-loop guard stood both lanes down after two identical failures; the step failure barrier surfaced the true ValueError on every occurrence.
revised_diagnosis: Rotation was sufficient but not necessary. The ~1e-11-area sliver cells sit deep enough in fp32 cross-product cancellation that ANY coordinate perturbation -- centering, rotation, or device-specific evaluation order -- can round their recomputed area to exact zero. The prior amendment's rotation-removal treated one trigger, not the hazard.

amendment.guard: DropDegenerateCells appended as the last pre-conversion transform in BOTH dataset variants: drops cells whose fp32 area is non-finite or non-positive, computed on the same device and points the model's validation will see. Dropped cells carry ~1e-12 of total measure.
amendment.resume: lanes RESUME from their checkpoints (epochs 73/206/296/153) rather than restarting: the guard's only effect is removing cells of numerically zero measure, whose loss contribution is zero to fp32 precision, so pre- and post-guard training are equivalent to roundoff -- unlike the augmentation change, which altered the data distribution and required the epoch-0 restart.
amendment.unchanged: arms, seeds, protocol, instrument, and every deciding gate
